sentences.text: An air-cushion vessel operating in the non-displacement mode adds an all-round flashing yellow light.
A wing-in-ground craft taking off, landing or flying near the surface adds a high-intensity all-round flashing red light.
A power-driven vessel under seven meters whose maximum speed doesn’t exceed seven knots may show an all-round white light instead, and shall, if practicable, also show sidelights.

On a power-driven vessel under twelve meters, the masthead or all-round light may be off the centerline if centerline fitting isn’t practicable, provided the sidelights are combined in one lantern near the centerline.
Inland, on the Great Lakes, a power-driven vessel may show an all-round white light in place of the second masthead light and the sternlight.
